name: Weekend in a city
summary: One walk, one meal, and a rain backup.
capability: Plans a short Saturday in a named city without inventing a closed venue.

outputs.name: plan
outputs.description: Walk, meal, and what to do if it rains.

onError: Name the part you could not plan. Do not invent a place.
script: Plan a Saturday in {{city}}: one walk, one meal, and a backup if it rains. Keep each stop to one sentence. If you are unsure a place is open, say so.
